jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a transparent 3x3 sheet of eight full walking poses and one idle pose, viewed from FRONT walking toward viewer. Input image 2 is the appearance and PROPORTION MASTER: the approved native red demon. Correct the target sheet's proportion mismatch ONLY. The walking demon has become too thin and its wings too narrow. Match the master's stocky muscular bulk, broad barrel chest/back, very thick upper arms and thighs and wide spread wings. At equal total figure height the approved master has a total silhouette WIDTH about 1.28 times its height. Every walking pose should be similarly broad: wingspan about 128% of overall feet-to-horns height, and torso/arm silhouette about 75% of that height. Keep head size, two horns, two grounded legs, two arms, two wings, dark claws and loincloth. Same red palette and painted pixel-art lighting; do not add highlights. Retain the exact EIGHT alternating forward-step leg poses and their chronology, direction, narrow foot placements and solid hand anatomy; correct the connected WHOLE figure, never graft body bands. Keep the nine equal cells in a 3x3 grid; reduce each full figure within its cell if needed to fit the broader wings with transparent margins. No cropping. No extra limbs, no tail, no flying, no props, no text, no shadows, no white matte. Output genuinely transparent alpha-zero background. Sharp native roguelike pixel art, not a smooth painting.
